checks.name: Candidate inventory preserves the prior release, Knowledge/Daily shell and exact Farid source-only additions
Prior git release installs and renders before any candidate update is attempted
corrupt candidate bundle fails installation while prior worker, exact cache and learning survive
missing candidate bundle fails installation while prior worker, exact cache and learning survive
Valid candidate waits for explicit activation and then replaces only the prior shell
Library, complete source sheets and both Knowledge URLs render through the cached bundled graph offline
All three public psychology studies remain readable from the verified shell offline

limitations: Actual desktop Chromium service workers and Cache Storage on localhost; offline is browser network emulation.
Fresh nonpersistent browser context and synthetic notes only. No real iPhone, Safari, iPad, VoiceOver or physical airplane-mode claim.
Tests missing and altered bundle installation plus explicit activation of the valid candidate; not storage exhaustion or every possible failed update.
A service-worker hash manifest is relative to trusted worker bytes. It does not authenticate rewritten HTML or a compromised worker.
